text: Become the sky for your emotions. Feel your emotions as clouds floating across the sky—they come and go, changing size, shape, and color. Stop identifying yourself with them. Realize yourself as a huge blue sky in which there is room for any clouds. Some clouds give cleansing rain, some on a hot day cover the sun, creating pleasant shade, some seem created especially to decorate the sky with grandiose castles in the air... Openness is not the expression of emotions, but giving them space to be.
